name: hermes_cli_models_compute_sale_discount
notes: Sale-discount derivation ladder (src/hermes_cli/models_py_helpers.c::models_compute_sale_discount vs LIVE hermes_cli/models.py::compute_sale_discount). FIXED THE PORT before gating: the C version ran the free/$0 branch AFTER the dict + was-empty early returns (LIVE runs it FIRST) and treated an empty/unparseable completion as a checkable 0 instead of None — so '0||' (natively-free model, no gateway original) returned no-sale in C but -100% chrome in LIVE. Also moved the was-* extraction behind the dict check. Inputs avoid exact .5 percent boundaries where LIVE banker's-rounding and C lround could differ (documented residual risk).
